name: Greg Lauren
why: One-of-a-kind garments rebuilt from vintage military cloth, tents and denim in a Los Angeles studio.
origin: Founded in 2011 by Greg Lauren, a painter and Ralph Lauren's nephew.

notes.craft: Every apparel PDP says 'Constructed in Los Angeles', and the brand overview PDF describes the process: vintage garments and army tents are deconstructed, and scraps are pieced into 'Scrapwork' yardage. Nothing on the site names or shows an owned LA studio or any maker or mill, so the making claim is a city of make plus a process description.
